proposed_from.topic: Exogenous-structure tractability frontier for Beckers structural-simplification actual causation. Fix a finite acyclic total nondeterministic SCM with explicit local tables, a specified actual solution, singleton X=x and Y=y events, and nonnegative rational edge-deletion costs. Under the full-graph reachability-closed and actualized-refinement legality rules, prove that full causal polyforests admit an exact minimum-cost value-path certificate: retained parents hit every bad-row difference support, safe relations compose along the unique path, and an O(L)-arithmetic dynamic program with polynomial bit complexity returns a positive witness, optimum certificate, or separating cut. Prove NP-completeness even for deterministic binary SCMs whose endogenous graph is one directed chain, actual world is zero, and total indegree is at most four, using shared exogenous selector roots and clause gates. Do not claim general treewidth FPT or unrestricted parsimonious certificate counting. Consumer: an explicit-support Beckers backend for the `actualcauses` Python package. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Independent derivations proved the local hitting equivalence, safe minimal-support transitions, forest completion and exact optimum, rational bit bounds, NP membership, and every selector/clause implication of the chain hardness reduction. Checks covered 52,488 local instances, 3,420 forest queries (2,467 ternary), 196 SAT instances, full state/edge cases, and the exogenous triangle counterexample to endogenous-only propagation. Classical HP tree and complexity results do not supply the Beckers-specific full-versus-endogenous separation. Normalized certificates, not unrestricted witnesses, carry the bijection. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the complete arbitrary-domain compiler and certificate verifier extensionally equal to canonical Beckers causation and minimum deletion cost, including actual-row freezing and topological completion, within the stated explicit-input bound. EARLY KILL TEST: Compare compiler verdicts, optima, and all certificate types with exhaustive legal-edge and alternate-state enumeration on every three-vertex full forest with domains at most three, a fixed five-vertex mixed-domain rational-cost batch, and the exogenous triangle; any mismatch stops extension. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest published positive result is EiterLukasiewicz2006Tractable; in its earlier UAI version, Section 4.1 and Theorems 4.2--4.3 decide Halpern--Pearl causes on bounded endogenous causal trees by recursively propagating families of subsets of path-variable domains. The proposed theorem changes the semantic operation at the first local step: it freezes the actual full parent row, unions outputs over deleted parent coordinates, and separately enforces full-graph reachability closure. The family \(\mathcal O_{\kappa}\) makes the separation exact: two candidate histories have the same \(G[V]\) layer and endogenous feasible-value state, but deletion of \(T_i\to C_i\) is legal only in the history that already removed \(T_i\to S_i\). This is a non-representability statement for a direct \(G[V]\)-only transfer of the unaugmented causal-tree state type to Beckers legality, not a criticism or alteration of the published Halpern--Pearl theorem. The closest semantic result is Section 6, Proposition 20 on page 525, with proof on page 532, of Beckers2025Actual, which guarantees a same-signature representative that simplifies both the original and actualized model but gives no encoded iff, optimum, certificate, or resource bound. Finiteness, explicit table encoding, and the full graph on \(U\cup V\) being a polyforest are novel backend-motivated computational restrictions rather than assumptions attributed to either comparator. The restricted hardness theorem shows that even a deterministic binary endogenous chain is hard once shared exogenous roots encode deletion legality. No located paper contains either half, and the joint positive-negative classification is stronger than a weighted version of a known tree recurrence or a generic SAT compilation.

seed_details.anchor_opened: Introduction, Definitions 15--21, Theorem 19, Proposition 22 and Conclusion were read; the proof boundary is the absence of any finite certificate or complexity theorem.
seed_details.kernel: Exact minimum-cost value-path certificates on full causal polyforests, paired with NP-completeness on deterministic binary endogenous chains through shared exogenous selectors.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Halpern--Pearl contingency propagation by actualize-then-project bad-support hitting, and carry deleted-edge reachability in the full graph.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for Beckers structural simplification with algorithms, complexity, certificates, forests, and polyforests located no matching theorem; the nearest results were Beckers's semantics, Halpern--Pearl tree algorithms, and approximate package search.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is not a default SCM effect-identification or bounding problem: the query is already semantically defined, and the new object is an exact certificate-and-complexity frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from EiterLukasiewicz2006Tractable because both proofs propagate values along a unique path.
seed_details.rebuttal: That paper propagates Halpern--Pearl contingency sets on an endogenous graph; it has neither actual-row freezing nor legal edge deletion, and the exogenous triangle makes an endogenous-only transfer false.

seed_details.anchor_opened: Introduction, actualized counterfactual semantics, Lemma 18, Theorem 15 and Conclusion were read; the proof boundary is an explicit replay theorem for arbitrary finite set-valued tables.
seed_details.kernel: A total compiler and independent certificate verifier are extensionally equivalent to canonical Beckers causation and minimum rational deletion cost.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Generalize the Boolean SAT witness-decoding argument to indexed finite relations while freezing the actual row before deleted-parent union and completing every accepted partial state topologically.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Exact searches combining arbitrary-domain NSCMs, structural simplification, compiler correctness, and certificates found Boolean Halpern--Pearl encodings and approximate black-box search, but no exact Beckers verifier contract.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The iff is extensional compiler correctness for a fixed Beckers query, not a do-calculus identification restatement; the explicit record formats and resource bound are first-class objects.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Proposition 22 of Beckers2025Actual because a same-graph structural simplification already exists.
seed_details.rebuttal: Proposition 22 is existential and semantic; it does not specify encoded records, prove both decoding directions, preserve rational objective values, certify negative instances, or bound compilation and verification.

seed_details.anchor_opened: Definitions 15--18 and Theorem 19 were read, including the qualitative statement that more deleted structure is more abnormal.
seed_details.kernel: Refine qualitative simplification abnormality by heterogeneous rational costs and derive an additive minimum certificate on full causal polyforests.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Prove that minimal supporting-row deletion masks do not double-count an edge and that nonnegative costs permit removal of every off-certificate deletion.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Weighted actual-cause optimization searches found IbrahimPretschner2020Optimization for Halpern--Pearl cause and contingency size, but no weighted Beckers edge-deletion optimum.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The cost-only form has a named optimum object but lacks a separate frontier beyond the principal certificate theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate weighted shortest path once the unweighted path certificate is known.
seed_details.rebuttal: The additive recurrence is routine after the certificate theorem; the hard content belongs in the joint frontier rather than a cost-only paper.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The graph simplification definition and generalized-function construction were read; both make declared but coordinate-constant edges potential legal deletion objects.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize exactly when coordinate-constant parent additions preserve Beckers cause verdicts and minimum deletion cost.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace ordinary interventional equivalence by a cost-preserving map between normalized deletion certificates that also commutes with full-graph reachability.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches located causal-abstraction preservation results but no commutation theorem for structural simplification and inert edge completion.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The object is a graph-presentation invariance condition, not an effect-identification functional.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate because a coordinate-constant parent does not change any observational or interventional response.
seed_details.rebuttal: Beckers manipulates declared edges, so inert additions can change reachability legality and cost; nevertheless this angle is narrower and less directly tied to the requested backend.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The structural-simplicity ordering in Section 5.1 and actual-cause definition in Section 6 were read.
seed_details.kernel: For affine edge costs \(c_e(\lambda)\), characterize every critical \(\lambda\) at which the optimum Beckers certificate changes on a full causal polyforest.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Lift each safe value transition to a lower envelope of affine deletion-mask costs and propagate piecewise-linear envelopes instead of scalar costs.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: No parametric structural-simplification optimization result was found; generic parametric shortest-path theory would supply much of the machinery.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The critical values are explicit, but generic parametric shortest-path machinery risks making the causal content derivative.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from parametric shortest paths after compiling the layered graph.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection largely holds because the destination algorithm is generic once the principal certificate theorem is available.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The published abstract and complexity classification were opened; the proof template encodes satisfiability into a counterfactual causal condition.
seed_details.kernel: Count normalized minimum Beckers deletion certificates on deterministic binary endogenous chains and relate the count parsimoniously to satisfying assignments.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Define normalization before counting so that redundant clause-edge deletions cannot multiply certificates for one assignment.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The search found counting results for Halpern--Pearl responsibility but no normalized Beckers certificate count.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The count is defined only after normalization and therefore does not support an unrestricted counting claim.
seed_details.red_team: The normalization is artificial and unrestricted witnesses are not in bijection with satisfying assignments.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is decisive for the present angle; normalized counting is not needed by the software consumer and unrestricted parsimony would be false.

seed_details.anchor_opened: Introduction, Algorithm 1 and its witness-decoding discussion were read; the encoding relies on Boolean literals and complementation.
seed_details.kernel: Enumerate all inclusion-minimal retained-parent hitting sets with polynomial delay and use them as local Beckers transitions for arbitrary finite tables.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace literal complementation by hypergraph transversals of bad-row difference supports.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The target collides with general minimal-transversal enumeration, whose output-sensitive complexity would dominate the causal contribution.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The local enumeration problem collapses toward generic hypergraph transversals and is not retained as a causal kernel.
seed_details.red_team: This is hypergraph transversal enumeration with causal notation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds unless additional path composition changes the enumeration problem, so the seed is dropped.

seed_details.anchor_opened: Introduction, the causal-tree value-set recurrence, Theorems 6.3--6.4 and Summary were read.
seed_details.kernel: Transfer polynomial causal-tree propagation to Beckers causation whenever the endogenous projection is a forest.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Attempt to propagate legal deletions using only endogenous path states.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The exogenous-triangle instance defeats the destination pair before a literature collision matters.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposed endogenous-only graph coordinate is falsified by the explicit exogenous triangle.
seed_details.red_team: False because shared exogenous parents create retained alternate paths invisible in the endogenous projection.
seed_details.rebuttal: No rebuttal survives; the seed is killed by \(I_{\triangle}\).

seed_details.anchor_opened: The unique-path recurrence and the outlook asking for further efficiently recognizable decompositions were read.
seed_details.kernel: Classify Beckers cause existence on full causal graphs with exactly one undirected cycle by a two-arc reachability state or a restricted hardness construction.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace unique-path independence by a joint state recording which of the two cycle arcs remains reachable after each candidate deletion.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: No Beckers unicycle or treewidth result was found; existing HP decompositions do not audit deletion reachability.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The question has a concrete two-arc state handle and does not claim a general treewidth algorithm.
seed_details.red_team: A one-cycle dynamic program is routine once the forest recurrence is written.
seed_details.rebuttal: It is unclear whether actual-row hitting and reachability can be summarized by the proposed finite state, so this remains a genuine open question rather than a promised theorem.
